_comment: Always-active core skill set injected at session start. full=body digest, pointer=name+description line. Names are canonical (aliases resolved via lib/skill_aliases at load). Budget: session-start-aggregator gives this block what is left of MAX_AGGREGATED_CHARS (5500) after the superpowers + MCP tails, about 4.3k chars; nine pointers take about 1.6k, so exactly one short body fits. Only caveman is full (capped at its Scope+Rules part); the rest are pointers the model loads with the Skill tool. tests/test_skills_wp2.py asserts every full entry actually arrives.
